obligations.source_text: An opaque undergarment-derived foundation and a separate tuxedo outerwear layer must both remain visibly distinct, with their overlap, crossing direction, and closure readable at first inspection.

bindings.outerwear_layer_adult_phrase: one unmistakably adult fashion subject wears the complete layered outfit
bindings.outerwear_layer_foundation_phrase: a constructed bralette camisole slip or bodysuit forms the visible foundation layer with opaque black satin molded cups and a wide supportive underband
bindings.outerwear_layer_outer_phrase: a separate blazer shirt cardigan trouser or skirt layer remains clearly present as a charcoal wool tuxedo jacket crossed once at the waist
bindings.outerwear_layer_construction_phrase: layer order intersections hems straps lapels and closures remain physically traceable across the satin underband and the charcoal jacket front
bindings.outerwear_layer_context_phrase: editorial lookbook backstage or public styling context keeps the image fashion-led inside the boutique-hotel dressing room

obligations.source_text: The physical mirror boundary, the reflected adult, the reflected hand-held phone, and the reflected room must form one continuous and spatially consistent mirror-selfie topology.

bindings.mirror_plane_phrase: a visible mirror edge thickness seam or reflected-room discontinuity establishes one physical reflective plane around the full antique-brass frame
bindings.mirror_subject_phrase: one clearly adult subject's face hair and body appear inside that same reflected space from head through mid-thigh
bindings.mirror_device_phrase: the reflected subject visibly grips one phone and the hand-to-device contact remains anatomically coherent through a firm right-hand grip
bindings.mirror_gaze_phrase: reflection gaze phone placement and any facial occlusion agree with the mirror geometry inside the same reflected room
bindings.mirror_boundary_phrase: a direct selfie empty mirror detached phone phone-screen image or software border does not substitute because brass frame depth and reflected-room continuity remain visible
